forecaster_note: Tue: S swell head-high to overhead at the southern magnets, chest-high on E-facing beaches, light variable offshore early then easing S and onshore winds from the arvo. Wed: leftover S/ENE, waist–chest, clean AM. Thu–Fri: new long-period S swell building. — Surfline forecaster, Tue 27 Oct

wind.summary: Calm SW 2 kph at 6am, W 8 kph 9am, WSW 7 kph noon — light offshore all morning; ENE 22 kph onshore from 3pm. Brief showers possible early, clearing to ~22°C.

shark.summary: No shark detections in the Palm Beach → Manly zone in the last 24h (last one: tagged white shark at Palm Beach receiver ~43h ago). Feed is current (newest statewide detection ~1h ago); 42 real detections statewide in 24h (Maroubra, Bennetts Beach, Yamba most active). DPI feed returned no features. Absence of detections is not a guarantee — check the live map before paddling out.

days.label: Today
days.note: S swell (602 kJ, 9s) with light variable offshore all morning — best window of the week, 6–11am. Southern ends (Curl Curl S, Manly) carry head-high; Dee Why wraps poorly. Onshore ENE from ~3pm.
days.surfline_text: S swell delivers head high to overhead surf at the southern magnets, chest high or so surf on the E facing beaks, smaller for shelter, but still some little waves getting in from ENE swell. Light, variable offshore winds offer a promising early morning window, with clean conditions at most breaks  Then from later morning S swell gradually eases, with chest to head high sets at the S exposures by later arvo. Moderate onshore winds develop, adding bump and reducing quality.

days.note: Leftover S + ENE swell, peaky waist-to-chest at the best exposures. Clean offshore morning, junky onshore arvo — a smaller, easier day.

days.label: Weekend
days.note: Beyond Surfline's window — estimated. Thu–Fri build is a new long-period S swell (head high, straight S so Dee Why wraps poorly); weekend should still carry size at S-exposed breaks.
days.surfline_text: Thu 29: New mixed shorter and longer south swell is expected to fill in through the day. Should be head high or so, to maybe a bit bigger at the south exposed breaks. Fri 30: Light N to offshore winds in the morning for cleanest window of the day. Plenty of size at the south exposed breaks from long period S swell - it might be a bit straight though - find a good bank or bit of reef.
